summary_text: Of 56 total findings released this period, 6 touch goals in Decentralization Industry Forum / Decentralized Identity Foundation's remit. Goals in remit: actor_identity, provenance, agent-identity, openness. The findings span the harness sources: GSPC axis 17: agent-identity (REGISTERING, adapter defined), GSPC axis 6: openness, GSPC axis 9: cross-reality, GSPC axis 23: effect-binding (REGISTERING, adapter defined), GSPC axis 3: provenance.

outreach_pack.cover_letter:
Dear Decentralization Industry Forum / Decentralized Identity Foundation,

This is a permissionless, openly-licensed measurement crosswalk for the period September 2026. Every figure is reproducible from the linked artifacts; every linked artifact carries a sha256 and an OpenTimestamps stamp. The CSOAI substrate does not certify, accredit, or rate — it measures, signs, and records. Please treat this as raw observation; we welcome challenge on method, scope, and conclusion.

Best,
Nicholas Templeman
Founder, CSOAI
